archetype: ELECTRIC & NEON / THE PERFORMANCE PRO HYBRID
spec_version: 2.0 — adds the marketing Command Center surface (sections landing_* below); runtime workbench sections above the divider remain the source of truth for authenticated pages

headings.usage: Bold animated typography, big kinetic hero moments, loop statuses, main panel titles. Do not use Inter or Space Grotesk.

body.usage: Event stream rail, code snippets, tool inputs, metadata, and data-heavy tables. Monospace gives it an OS/workbench feel.

labels.usage: Overlines, tags, status pills, memory nodes, panel headers.

accent.description: Electric Acid Green. Signals 'alive and thinking'. Highly kinetic and cognitive. Contrast heavily against dark void base. Avoid purple/violet AI-slop.

liquid_glass.usage: Used for floating controls, bottom dock, model switcher, and overlay panels (Dock.cool style).

textures.noise: Subtle grain texture overlaid on panels via background-image to remove flat digital sterility. Adds 'nominal' tactile feel.

borders.style: Sharp 1px semi-transparent borders (border-white/10). No soft muddy shadows.

cursor.style: Custom animated geometric cursor (using framer-motion) that reacts to hover states (e.g., expands on interactive elements).

layouts.overall_structure: Hybrid Fullstack Workbench / OS Dashboard. 100vh, hidden main scrollbar. Heavy reliance on independent panel scrolling.

regions.left_rail: Loop tree and navigation (Knowledge Graph shortcuts, Planner tree). Width: ~280px.
regions.right_rail: Live Event Bus stream. width: ~320px. Monospaced cascading feed of events.
regions.center_canvas: Dynamic Artifact Renderer. Wide workspace for algorithms, architecture viewer, comparison matrices.
regions.bottom_dock: Floating liquid-glass dock centered at bottom. Contains Model Switcher, play/pause/branch, intervention input. Z-index 50.

layouts.spacing: Extreme confidence in whitespace. Generous padding in center canvas (p-12 to p-24). Tight data density in side panels (p-4, gap-2).

grids.bento: High density grid for Memory Browser and Skill Generator (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4, gap-4). Fill items h-full.
grids.timeline: Linear tracking row for Research Timeline scrubber, horizontal overflow hidden, custom scrollbar.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or sharp structural (rounded-none). Accent buttons must glow on hover.
components.panels: Dark solid base (bg-[#0A0A0A]) with 1px border-white/10. No glassmorphism here, to preserve data legibility. Glass is only for floating docks.
components.event_stream: Cascading feed. Use Framer Motion (layout, initial, animate) for items sliding in with spring physics.
components.confidence_meter: Animated SVG ring/bar with glow drop-shadow matching confidence level. Color shifts from warning (orange) to success (acid green).
components.model_switcher: Liquid animation toggle pill in the dock. Spring physics to snap between Llama/Claude/GPT.
components.shadcn_overrides: Use Shadcn purely for behavior (Dropdown, Tooltips, Dialogs) but strip generic styling. Apply liquid glass to Tooltip/Dropdown content wrappers.

motion.physics: Spring physics for drags/hovers (stiffness: 300, damping: 25). Avoid linear easing.
motion.data_viz: Connections drawing between graph nodes (stroke-dasharray animation). Loop status pulsing.
motion.hover_states: Tactile depth. Glossy highlights passing over the liquid-glass dock items on hover.

3d_and_data_libraries.graph_viz: React Flow or Visx for Knowledge Graph and Reasoning Tree (interactive nodes, custom edges).
3d_and_data_libraries.motion: Framer Motion for layout transitions, Event Bus item sliding, and custom cursor.
3d_and_data_libraries.scrollytelling: Not applicable to the runtime workbench (fixed 100vh). Use D3/Visx for Artifact Canvas rendering. Scrollytelling applies only to the marketing landing — see landing_motion_spec.

dark_liquid_abstract.description: Dark blue/black liquid abstract for possible hero/login overlay.
Abstract fluid paint, usable for dynamic artifact backgrounds if darkened via overlay.

textures.description: Grainy black and white abstract texture. Use as a fixed background layer with opacity 0.03 to create tactile 'nominal' noise.
Black and white photo of a dark background for subtle depth.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain APCA minimums. Use text-white for primary, text-white/60 for secondary. Acid green on dark bg ensures extreme contrast.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query by snapping state transitions instead of springing.
accessibility.test_ids: Include data-testid kebab-case attributes on all dock controls, event bus items, and loop inspector actions.

landing_design_system.scope: The marketing Command Center experience at '/' (loader, header, six sections, footer). Extends — never contradicts — the tokens above. Runtime pages are unaffected.
landing_design_system.positioning: An AI Command Center: calm authority, not neon spectacle. Signal color is rationed; darkness, hairlines, and whitespace carry the premium feel.

display_hero.note: Set in solid white. Never gradient text. One accent word may carry the acid color.

section_intro.note: Deliberate deviation from the workbench: long-form reading copy on the landing uses Cabinet Grotesk for comfort; JetBrains Mono is reserved for overlines, data, captions, and terminal-styled fragments.

overline.note: Prefixed with a 24px hairline rule in acid when paired with a section title.

data_caption.usage: Pipeline node labels, metric captions, footer fine print.

surfaces.hairline: rgba(255,255,255,0.08) — borders; rgba(255,255,255,0.05) for structural grid lines

signal.acid: #D4FF00 — live states, primary CTA, progress. Rationed: at most 5% of any viewport
signal.cyan: #00E5FF — secondary signal: data links, info states, pipeline highlight on focus
signal.rule: Acid and cyan never appear together in the same headline or button. Acid = action and life; cyan = information and connection.

color_system.depth_via_luminance: Depth comes from stepped surface colors (void -> panel -> raised) plus 1px hairlines — not from shadows and not from dark gradients. Glow is reserved for acid signal elements only.

section_padding_y.note: Hero gets min-h-[100svh] instead of vertical padding.

spacing_and_rhythm.asymmetry_rule: Alternate alignment by section: hero left-aligned, intelligence layer full-bleed, pillars offset 1-column right, use cases full grid, outcomes split 7/5, CTA centered. Never repeat the same centered headline-subtitle-CTA stack twice.

z_stack.ambient_field: z-0 — faint blueprint grid (1px lines, rgba(255,255,255,0.03), 64px cells) plus grain at 0.03 opacity; fixed, non-interactive

depth_and_layers.signature_detail: Corner brackets: 12px L-shaped hairlines in rgba(255,255,255,0.25) on two corners of key modules (hero centerpiece, pipeline frame, CTA card). A quiet HUD cue that recurs nowhere else.
depth_and_layers.ambient_parallax: The grid field and grain move at 0.05–0.08 of scroll velocity; sections scroll normally over them.

button_primary.style: rounded-full, bg-[#D4FF00] text-[#050505], Cabinet Grotesk extrabold, text-sm md:text-base, px-8 h-12 md:h-14
button_primary.active: scale 0.97 via snappy spring; glow contracts

button_ghost.style: rounded-full, border border-white/15 text-white/80, h-12 md:h-14 px-6

card.style: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8
card.rule: Cards never glow. Glow belongs to live signal elements only.

nav_link.style: JetBrains Mono 12px uppercase tracking 0.18em text-white/50; min touch target 44px via padding
nav_link.hover: text-white; a 12px acid underline wipes in from the left

landing_components.focus_visibility: Every interactive element shows a 2px #D4FF00 focus-visible outline at 2px offset. Focus rings are never removed.

principles: Motion explains causality: things enter from where they logically come from and exit where they go.
One kinetic protagonist per viewport. The loader owns arrival; the pipeline owns the middle; counters and cards stay quiet around them.
Compositor-only properties: animate transform, opacity, and filter only. Never animate width, height, top, left, or box-shadow directly (fake glow with opacity on a pre-rendered shadow element).
Nothing waits on motion: content is interactive the instant it exists; animation never gates a click.

physics.rule: No linear easing anywhere except the pipeline packet loop, which is deliberately mechanical.

loading_sequence.budget: 1.2s total on desktop, hard cap 3s on throttled mobile (AC-2); skippable by tap; skipped entirely under prefers-reduced-motion (0.3s static fade instead)

choreography.event: Void background with mono overline 'LOOPAER // COMMAND CENTER' typewriter-in, 14ms per glyph, caret blink
Wordmark letters mask-reveal: each letter translates y 100% to 0 inside an overflow-hidden line, 40ms stagger, 500ms expo-out
A 1px acid rule draws left-to-right beneath the wordmark (600ms ease-in-out), ending in a small terminal tick
Loader veil (opacity 1 to 0, 250ms) lifts while the hero headline words stagger in from below; header slides down 12px and fades in
Loader node removed from DOM; page fully interactive

loading_sequence.implementation: Render the loader as a sibling overlay, not a gate on data fetching. Section content mounts underneath immediately; only its reveal animations wait. If fonts are not ready by t=0, run the sequence with system fallback and swap silently.
loading_sequence.reduced_motion_fallback: Static wordmark + overline fade in over 300ms; no typewriter, no rule draw.

cursor_and_pointer.availability: Fine pointers only — enable behind matchMedia('(pointer: fine)') and width >= 1024; never on touch devices, where it would fight native scrolling
cursor_and_pointer.composition: 8px solid acid dot plus a 32px 1px ring at rgba(255,255,255,0.5)
behavior: Dot tracks pointer 1:1; ring follows on spring_standard
Over interactive elements: ring expands to 44px, opacity rises to 0.9
Over text: ring contracts to 4px tall bar
On press: ring scales to 0.8, dot brightens
Idle 4s: ring fades to 0.25 opacity; returns on move
cursor_and_pointer.magnetic_targets: Primary CTA and pipeline nodes pull up to 6px toward the pointer inside a 56px field; spring_snappy; no magnetism on mobile

hover_and_click_microinteractions.cards: 250ms lift + border brighten (see landing_components.card); inner icon rotates 6 degrees
hover_and_click_microinteractions.use_case_chips: background wipes from left with white/5, 200ms
hover_and_click_microinteractions.click_ripple_rule: No material-style ripples. Press feedback is scale + a 120ms brightness pulse only.
hover_and_click_microinteractions.differentiation_rule: Each pillar card gets one unique micro-interaction (e.g. live ticker, ring fill, toggle flip, edge draw); never the same hover on two adjacent modules.

button_feedback.hover: translate-y -1px; primary gains 24px acid glow; ghost gains white/5 fill
button_feedback.press: scale 0.97 on spring_snappy; release overshoots to 1.0 by 3%
button_feedback.disabled: opacity 0.4, no hover transform, cursor not-allowed
button_feedback.loading: Label cross-fades to a mono status word (e.g. 'OPENING'); a 14px acid arc spinner sits left of it

scroll_reveals.masked_text_reveal: Headlines split into lines, each line inside overflow-hidden, y 100% to 0, 700ms, 80ms stagger
scroll_reveals.parallax_cap: Ambient layers only, factor 0.05–0.08, transform-only, disabled under reduced motion
scroll_reveals.offscreen_hygiene: Canvases and looping animations unmount or pause when offscreen for more than 2 viewports and on document.visibilitychange hidden

pipeline_centerpiece.structure: SVG flow diagram: source -> intake -> agents -> memory -> outcome nodes as glass panels, edges as 1.5px paths
pipeline_centerpiece.entry: When section reaches 30% viewport: edges draw via stroke-dashoffset over 1.2s with 150ms stagger along flow order, then nodes pop in (scale 0.96 to 1, 300ms spring_standard)
pipeline_centerpiece.ambient_loop: Acid packet dots travel the paths on linear timing, 3s per lap, staggered starts; a faint cyan echo follows at 40% opacity
pipeline_centerpiece.pointer_interaction: Hover or tap a node: connected edges lift to cyan, all other edges dim to 30% opacity, a glass tooltip panel opens beside the node with a mono caption; 200ms transitions
pipeline_centerpiece.touch_interaction: Tap toggles node focus; tapping the diagram background clears focus; every node hit-area is at least 44x44px
pipeline_centerpiece.reduced_motion_fallback: Diagram renders fully drawn on entry; packets hidden; focus highlighting stays as an instant state change

landing_motion_spec.reduced_motion_contract: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce — every entrance becomes an instant or 200ms opacity fade; loops (packets, caret, pulses) stop; parallax and magnetism disabled; the loader is skipped. Functionality is identical (AC-8).

header.desktop: fixed, h-16, flex justify-between, px-10 inside max-w-[1200px]; left: wordmark in Cabinet Grotesk extrabold; center: 4 mono nav links; right: ghost 'Sign in' + primary 'Start a consultation' (compact h-10). Liquid-glass background rgba(10,10,10,0.6) blur(16px) appears only after 24px of scroll.
header.mobile: h-14, px-5; wordmark left; single 44px menu button right opening a full-screen liquid-glass sheet with 48px-tall links and both CTAs; sheet animates y -16px fade, 250ms expo-out

section_0_loader.layout: Full-viewport fixed overlay; content vertically centered but horizontally left-aligned at the content container edge — the loader inherits the page's left alignment to avoid a generic centered splash.

section_1_hero.desktop: min-h-[100svh]; left-aligned block in the content container: overline, 2–3 line kinetic headline, one intro paragraph max-w-[34rem], two CTAs (primary + ghost) side by side. Right 45% hosts the lazy-loaded three.js centerpiece (orbiting pipeline ring). Bottom edge: a mono status strip (system nominal line) that types in once.
section_1_hero.mobile: Single column; headline first, intro, full-width stacked CTAs (h-12, gap-3); the 3D scene downgrades to a lightweight animated SVG ring behind the text at reduced opacity; status strip at bottom
section_1_hero.note: Left alignment and the status strip are the deliberate anti-template moves.

section_2_intelligence_layer.desktop: Full-bleed section. Overline + title left-aligned top. The pipeline centerpiece spans the container width (sticky within a 150vh scroll region so edges finish drawing while text beside it advances). Caption row of mono node labels under the diagram.
section_2_intelligence_layer.mobile: Diagram becomes horizontally scrollable (scroll-snap, native momentum) at a 4:3 aspect card; node labels wrap into a legend below; sticky behavior disabled

section_3_pillars.desktop: 12-column grid; title block columns 1–5; pillar modules columns 6–12 in a staggered 2-column arrangement with 32px vertical offsets — not a uniform row. Each module gets its unique micro-interaction per landing_motion_spec.
section_3_pillars.mobile: Single column, full-width modules, reveal stagger 80ms

section_4_use_cases.desktop: Filter row of mono pill chips (h-10, gap-2, wrap) then a 3-column card grid (gap-6). Card: mono function tag, Cabinet Grotesk title, 2-line description, arrow link. Filtering animates with layout springs (framer-motion layout).
section_4_use_cases.mobile: Filter chips become a horizontally scrolling row with snap and edge fade; cards stack 1-column; tap opens an in-place expansion (height spring) rather than a new route

section_5_outcomes.desktop: Split 7/5: left holds qualitative outcome statements as masked-text reveals; right holds one animated diagram (self-drawn lines and our own placeholder figures only — per brief section 7 decision: qualitative first, no competitor numbers).

section_6_consultation_cta.desktop: Centered closing card inside the container: overline, one-sentence invitation, single primary CTA, mono reassurance line beneath (e.g. response time). Corner brackets frame the card. CTA connects to the existing consultation flow.
section_6_consultation_cta.mobile: Full-width card, px-5, CTA full-width h-14

footer.desktop: border-t white/10; three columns: wordmark + one line; mono nav; mono legal. py-12.
footer.mobile: Single column stack, 44px tap targets, py-10

touch: Every interactive target is at least 44x44 CSS px (AC-4), achieved via padding, not by enlarging visuals
No hover-only interactions: anything revealed on hover is also reachable by tap or is visible by default
Spacing between adjacent targets at least 8px to prevent mis-taps
Custom cursor, magnetism, and pointer parallax are disabled whenever (pointer: coarse)
viewport_hygiene: Use 100svh (fallback 100vh) for the hero so mobile browser chrome never clips CTAs
No horizontal page overflow at any width; internal horizontal scroll is snap-contained
Fluid type via clamp() instead of breakpoint jumps wherever the scale table defines a clamp
feature_downgrades: three.js hero scene: lazy-loaded only after first paint; replaced by the SVG ring under (pointer: coarse) + small screens, or when deviceMemory < 4
Grain texture: opacity reduced to 0.02 on mobile to save compositing cost
Sticky pipeline region: disabled below lg

targets.first_contentful_paint: < 2.5s on mid-range phone profile with 4G throttling (AC-9)

allocation_guidance.framer_motion: Use LazyMotion + domAnimation and import 'm' — budget ~32KB gz, not the full package
allocation_guidance.three_js: Lazy-loaded via React.lazy after first paint; excluded from the critical path; scene code + three budget ~120KB gz but loaded async and never counted against FCP

animation_costs: Compositor-only animation (transform/opacity/filter); zero animated layout properties
One looping canvas max per viewport; loops pause when offscreen or tab hidden
backdrop-filter limited to header and menu sheet; never applied to full sections on mobile
will-change only on the actively animating element, removed on idle
assets: Fonts: self-hosted WOFF2 subsets, two families, at most 5 weights total, font-display: swap
Textures: inline or under 30KB each; no blocking remote images in critical sections
Remote image_urls from the workbench era are optional decor only and must load lazily
performance_budget.measurement: Verify with Lighthouse mobile + a performance trace per AC-2 and AC-9 before sign-off; CRA code-splitting limits are managed via craco and React.lazy boundaries.

hand_drawn_readme_style.concept: The README reads like an engineer's field notebook: hand-drawn ink sketches on paper that explain the platform, with animation bringing the system loops to life. No emoji, no screenshots, no default markdown prose blocks beyond short captions.

stroke_style.line_weight: 2px primary strokes; 1.25px for hatching and fine annotation
stroke_style.character: Deliberate imperfection: corners overshoot by 2–4px, boxes sit at 0.5–1.5 degree tilts, long lines carry one gentle bow; use 2–3 point jitter on anchors. No perfect rectangles, no uniform dashes.
stroke_style.hatching: Diagonal 45-degree hatch fills at 6px spacing for shaded areas, never solid fills except signal chips

palette.adaptation: Each SVG carries an internal prefers-color-scheme media query so it renders correctly in both GitHub themes
palette.rule: Signal color marks only live paths and key outcomes; everything else is ink and annotation.

typography_in_sketches.labels: SVG text converted to outlined paths so GitHub renders them identically everywhere; hand-lettered style matching Cabinet Grotesk geometry
typography_in_sketches.annotations: System hand-style stack: font-family 'Segoe Print','Bradley Hand',cursive with monospace fallback; 13px minimum
typography_in_sketches.captions: Standard markdown italic line under each figure, mono-safe, sentence case

animation_rules: CSS keyframes inside the SVG (no SMIL); every animation wrapped in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)
Draw-in: stroke-dashoffset animation 2.4s ease-out, run once
Live loop: acid packet dot along the main data path, 3.2s linear infinite — mirrors the site pipeline loop for brand continuity
Pulse: key components breathe opacity 0.85 to 1 over 2s
GIF fallback allowed only where GitHub strips CSS animation; the GIF must keep the same palette and stroke rules
Total loop cost: each SVG under 120KB; prefer CSS over embedded scripts

order: 1. Wordmark sketch with one-line claim (hand-drawn logo, acid underline draw-in)
2. What it is: a single ink panel with three annotated lines
3. Architecture sketch: boxes for frontend, FastAPI runtime, MongoDB, websocket bus, LLM gateway; dashed connectors with open arrowheads; live path highlighted in signal
4. The loop: animated diagram of a pipeline cycle (plan, act, observe, remember) with the traveling packet
5. Stack badges: hand-drawn chips for React, FastAPI, MongoDB, websockets
6. Quick start: a sketched terminal window with outlined-lettering commands and a caret blink
layout_rules: Figures stack vertically, centered, max display width 900px, with one caption each
Whitespace between figures at least 48px rendered; sections divided by a short hand-drawn rule, not full-width <hr>
No figure depends on color alone; every live path also carries a dashed pattern
No emoji anywhere, including alt text

file_conventions.naming: kebab-case: wordmark.svg, architecture.svg, the-loop.svg, stack-badges.svg, terminal.svg
file_conventions.viewbox: 0 0 900 N; stroke widths defined in viewBox units so scaling keeps weights consistent

implementation_fidelity_checklist: All six sections render in order at 360px and desktop (AC-1)
Loader completes under 1.5s desktop / 3s throttled mobile and never gates content mounting (AC-2)
Pipeline animates on scroll entry and responds to pointer and touch (AC-3)
Every interactive target is >= 44x44px with >= 8px spacing; no hover-only behavior (AC-4)
Zero emoji in code, copy, comments, commits, and README assets (AC-5)
No competitor brands, metrics, or claims anywhere (AC-6)
No sentence survives verbatim from the old Landing.jsx (AC-7)
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce renders the full fallback contract; functionality unchanged (AC-8)
FCP under 2.5s and JS under 350KB gzipped on the phone profile (AC-9)
Backend surface untouched: no new endpoints consumed beyond existing public reads; static fallback renders when API unreachable (AC-10)
README replaced with hand-drawn animated visuals that render on GitHub in both themes (AC-11)
Commits authored as abhays02 with humanized messages (AC-12)
Color discipline: acid under 5% of viewport, no dark gradients, no purple/violet, cards never glow
Type discipline: solid white headlines (no gradient text), clamp() fluid sizes, mono reserved for overlines/data/captions
Motion discipline: compositor-only properties, spring presets from this spec, no linear easing except packet loops, one kinetic protagonist per viewport
Depth discipline: z-stack order respected; glass only on header/menu/tooltips; corner brackets only on the three designated modules
Cursor only on fine pointers >= 1024px; fully absent on touch
three.js lazy-loaded after first paint with SVG fallback; offscreen canvases paused or unmounted
Focus-visible acid ring present on every interactive element; keyboard order follows DOM order
Each pillar carries a distinct micro-interaction; no repeated card hover pattern
data-testid attributes in kebab-case on all landing CTAs, filters, pipeline nodes, and menu controls
Self-hosted font subsets with display swap; no blocking remote images above the fold
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy (Base -> Panels -> Liquid Glass Dock).
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur, rgba) ONLY for floating or overlay UI elements (dock, tooltips, dialogs). Data panels must be solid for legibility.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp buttons with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons. Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable in layout canvases. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Main agent MUST rely on the provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder text for images.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable, but override their generic SaaS feel with extreme dark mode + acid green styling.
Use `sonner` for toasts. It is located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx`.
instructions_to_main_agent: Construct a 100vh app with a 3-column structural grid (Left Rail, Center Canvas, Right Rail) and a fixed Bottom Dock.
Ensure `data-testid` is added to all interactive elements, e.g. `data-testid='dock-model-switcher'`.
Leverage Framer Motion heavily for the Event Bus stream (animate items entering).
Use JetBrains Mono or similar for the Event stream and Code blocks. Use Cabinet Grotesk for the massive panel titles.
DO NOT use a transparent background in the header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it. Use Liquid Glass (blur + rgba) or solid colors.
Inject the noise texture URL via CSS background-image across the app background.

For the marketing landing at '/', follow landing_design_system, landing_motion_spec, landing_page_layouts, responsive_rules, and performance_budget; keep the workbench instructions above for runtime pages only.
